purpose: Preserve exact historical comparison bytes while retaining one browsable active wiki.

authorizing_input.source: User turn in the Workbench knowledge comparison Codex chat
authorizing_input.exact_text: OK, now safe remove duplicate llm wikis documents only keep authed one. The rule is openKB as primary llm-wiki if provide llm url and token other wise use llm-wiki-agent instead.

archive.format: gzip-compressed POSIX tar; sorted regular-file members; uid/gid and timestamps normalized; original content bytes and file modes preserved

verification.method: Generated the same archive twice and compared its bytes; reopened saved archive and checked every member size and SHA-256 against original files before removal.

recovery.instructions: Extract selected members into a temporary directory outside the active knowledge workspace. Member prefixes openkb/ and llm-wiki/ identify the original comparison trees; original_project_path records their former repository locations.
recovery.limits: The expanded snapshots were untracked at consolidation; the archive and manifest are the exact recovery source. Recovered snapshots are historical evidence, not an active or approved wiki.

files.preservation_reason: Original comparison output and provenance retained after consolidation of expanded historical wiki trees.
